mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(u.user_id) FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE u.del_flag = '0' -- 排除已删除的废弃账号 -- 🎯 核心过滤：只统计这两个学生系部的人数，排除“教师”部门 AND d.dept_name IN ('计算机科学与技术', '软件工程')
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM biz_course WHERE status = 1
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(arrived_amount), 0) FROM biz_research_project WHERE status = 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM biz_research_paper WHERE status = 1

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y') as statYear, IFNULL(SUM(contract_amount), 0) as contractAmount, IFNULL(SUM(arrived_amount), 0) as arrivedAmount FROM biz_research_project WHERE status = 1 GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y') ORDER BY statYear ASC

SELECT CASE -- SCI 论文：展示类型 + 分区 (如: SCI-一区) WHEN paper_type = '1' THEN CONCAT('SCI-', IFNULL(sci_zone, '其他')) -- 卓越期刊：区分是否领军 WHEN paper_type = '2' THEN CASE WHEN is_excellent_leading = '1' THEN '卓越领军期刊' ELSE '卓越期刊' END -- CCF 会议：展示类型 + 等级 (如: CCF-A等) WHEN paper_type = '3' THEN CONCAT('CCF-', IFNULL(ccf_zone, '其他')) ELSE '其他论文' END as name, COUNT(1) as value FROM biz_research_paper WHERE status = 1 -- 只统计审核通过的 GROUP BY name

SELECT d.dept_name as name, COUNT(u.user_id) as value FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON u.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE u.del_flag = '0' -- 排除已删除的账号 AND d.dept_name IN ('计算机科学与技术', '教师', '软件工程') -- 精准狙击你截图里的部门名称 GROUP BY d.dept_name ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN '申请开课中' WHEN status = 1 THEN '审核已通过' WHEN status = 2 THEN '申请已驳回' ELSE '其他状态' END as name, COUNT(1) as value FROM biz_course GROUP BY status

SELECT course_name as name, current_numofpeople as current, volume, ROUND(current_numofpeople * 100.0 / volume, 2) as value -- 饱和度百分比 FROM biz_course WHERE status = 1 AND volume > 0 ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT CASE WHEN learn_status = 0 THEN '未开始' WHEN learn_status = 1 THEN '正在修读' WHEN learn_status = 2 THEN '已结课' ELSE '其他' END as name, COUNT(1) as value FROM biz_student_course GROUP BY learn_status
